title: Polvere di stelle
writer: Ruggero Maccari, Alberto Sordi, Bernardino Zapponi
actors: Alberto Sordi, Monica Vitti, John Phillip Law
plot: Mimmo Adami and Dea Dani are local professional dancers in the impoverished Italy of World War II. Their lives change suddenly as American soldiers stop in their town hoping to be entertained in accordance with the Broadway style.
